entries.definition_en: a small animal with soft fur that people keep at home
entries.example_en: Our cat sleeps in the sun all afternoon.
entries.example_vi: Con mèo nhà mình ngủ dưới nắng cả buổi chiều.
entries.cloze_en: My cat sleeps on my bed and likes to eat fish.

entries.definition_en: an animal that barks, often kept as a pet
entries.example_en: My dog waits for me at the gate.
entries.example_vi: Con chó nhà mình đợi mình ở cổng.
entries.cloze_en: My dog likes to run in the park and play with a ball.

entries.definition_en: the large area of salt water on the earth
entries.example_en: The sea in Nha Trang is very blue.
entries.example_vi: Biển Nha Trang rất xanh.
entries.cloze_en: The sea in Nha Trang is very blue, and we swim in it.

entries.definition_en: to try to catch fish as a hobby
entries.example_en: Grandpa and I go fishing at the lake.
entries.example_vi: Ông và mình đi câu cá ở hồ.
entries.cloze_en: Grandpa and I go fishing at the river. We get three fish.

entries.definition_en: an animal with wings and feathers that can fly
entries.example_en: A small bird sings in the tree.
entries.example_vi: Một chú chim nhỏ hót trên cây.
entries.cloze_en: A small bird sings in the tree and flies away.

entries.definition_en: a public place with grass and trees
entries.example_en: Old people do exercises in the park every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào người già cũng tập thể dục ở công viên.
entries.cloze_en: There are trees, flowers and a small lake in the park.

entries.definition_en: to move through water using your arms and legs
entries.example_en: Can you swim? I can swim a little.
entries.example_vi: Bạn biết bơi không? Mình bơi được một chút.
entries.cloze_en: Fish can swim in the water.

entries.definition_en: a tall plant with a trunk, branches and leaves
entries.example_en: There is a big tree in our yard.
entries.example_vi: Sân nhà mình có một cái cây to.
entries.cloze_en: There is a big tree with green leaves in our yard.

entries.definition_en: a living thing that can move, like a dog or bird
entries.example_en: What is your favorite animal?
entries.example_vi: Con vật bạn thích nhất là gì?
entries.cloze_en: A tiger is a big animal with four legs.

entries.definition_en: the colorful part of a plant
entries.example_en: We buy flowers for Teachers' Day.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình mua hoa tặng ngày Nhà giáo.
entries.cloze_en: This red flower in the garden has a nice smell.

entries.definition_en: a large farm animal that gives milk
entries.example_en: The cows eat grass in the field.
entries.example_vi: Những con bò ăn cỏ trên cánh đồng.
entries.cloze_en: The cow eats grass in the field and gives us milk.

entries.definition_en: to go somewhere to swim for fun
entries.example_en: We go swimming on hot summer days.
entries.example_vi: Ngày hè nóng tụi mình đi bơi.
entries.cloze_en: It is very hot, so we go swimming in the sea.

entries.definition_en: an animal you keep at home and love
entries.example_en: Do you have a pet at home?
entries.example_vi: Ở nhà bạn có nuôi thú cưng không?
entries.cloze_en: My pet is a small dog. I give him food every day.

entries.definition_en: a pink or black farm animal with a short nose
entries.example_en: My grandma keeps two pigs on her farm.
entries.example_vi: Bà mình nuôi hai con lợn ở trang trại.
entries.cloze_en: My grandma has a pink pig on her farm.

entries.definition_en: a place where you can see wild animals
entries.example_en: Our class visits the zoo on Friday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Sáu lớp mình đi thăm sở thú.
entries.cloze_en: At the zoo, we see lions, tigers and monkeys.

entries.definition_en: land and buildings where people grow food and keep animals
entries.example_en: My uncle has a small farm with chickens.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình có một trang trại nhỏ nuôi gà.
entries.cloze_en: My uncle has a farm with cows, pigs and chickens.

entries.definition_en: to plant something and help it get bigger
entries.example_en: We grow tomatoes on the roof.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình trồng cà chua trên sân thượng.
entries.cloze_en: We grow tomatoes and vegetables in our garden.

entries.definition_en: a large wild cat with yellow fur
entries.example_en: The lion at the zoo is sleeping.
entries.example_vi: Con sư tử ở sở thú đang ngủ.
entries.cloze_en: At the zoo, the lion is a big yellow animal with long hair on its head.

entries.definition_en: the land with sand next to the sea
entries.example_en: We play games on the beach in summer.
entries.example_vi: Mùa hè tụi mình chơi trò chơi trên bãi biển.
entries.cloze_en: In summer, we swim in the sea and play on the beach.

entries.definition_en: to walk for fun or exercise
entries.example_en: Let's take a walk around the lake.
entries.example_vi: Mình đi dạo quanh hồ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: After dinner, we take a walk around the lake.

entries.definition_en: a short green plant that covers the ground
entries.example_en: Please don't walk on the grass.
entries.example_vi: Vui lòng không giẫm lên cỏ.
entries.cloze_en: Cows and sheep eat green grass in the field.

entries.definition_en: a large animal that people can ride
entries.example_en: I ride a horse for the first time.
entries.example_vi: Lần đầu tiên mình cưỡi ngựa.
entries.cloze_en: I ride a horse on the farm. It runs very fast.

entries.definition_en: a long line of water that goes to the sea
entries.example_en: The Red River goes through Hanoi.
entries.example_vi: Sông Hồng chảy qua Hà Nội.
entries.cloze_en: We take a boat across the river to the other side.

entries.definition_en: a large wild cat with orange and black lines
entries.example_en: The tiger is a strong animal.
entries.example_vi: Hổ là loài vật rất khỏe.
entries.cloze_en: The tiger is a big, strong animal with orange and black colors.

entries.definition_en: a person who works on a farm
entries.example_en: The farmer works in the rice field all day.
entries.example_vi: Người nông dân làm việc trên ruộng lúa cả ngày.
entries.cloze_en: The farmer grows rice in the field all day.

entries.definition_en: an animal that lives in trees and likes to climb
entries.example_en: The monkey eats a banana in the tree.
entries.example_vi: Chú khỉ ăn chuối trên cây.
entries.cloze_en: The monkey climbs the tree and eats a banana.

entries.definition_en: to visit the beach for fun
entries.example_en: Let's go to the beach this weekend!
entries.example_vi: Cuối tuần này đi biển đi!
entries.cloze_en: It's very hot, so let's go to the beach and swim in the sea.

entries.definition_en: a meal you eat outside, often in a park
entries.example_en: We have a picnic by the river.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi dã ngoại bên bờ sông.
entries.cloze_en: We bring food and sit on the grass for a picnic by the river.

entries.definition_en: a small animal with long ears
entries.example_en: My pet rabbit eats green vegetables.
entries.example_vi: Con thỏ nhà mình ăn rau xanh.
entries.cloze_en: My pet rabbit has long ears and eats green vegetables.

entries.definition_en: a very high hill
entries.example_en: This mountain is very high and cold.
entries.example_vi: Ngọn núi này rất cao và lạnh.
entries.cloze_en: This mountain is very high, and it is cold at the top.

entries.definition_en: the sport or activity of swimming
entries.example_en: Swimming is my favorite sport in summer.
entries.example_vi: Bơi là môn thể thao mình thích nhất vào mùa hè.
entries.cloze_en: I love swimming in the sea every summer.

entries.definition_en: a flying insect that makes honey
entries.example_en: A bee is on the yellow flower.
entries.example_vi: Một con ong đậu trên bông hoa vàng.
entries.cloze_en: A bee flies to the yellow flower to get food.

entries.definition_en: a large strong animal with thick fur
entries.example_en: The bear at the zoo likes honey.
entries.example_vi: Con gấu ở sở thú thích mật ong.
entries.cloze_en: The big brown bear sleeps all winter in the mountains.

entries.definition_en: a place where people stay in tents
entries.example_en: Our summer camp is near the lake.
entries.example_vi: Trại hè của tụi mình ở gần hồ.
entries.cloze_en: At our summer camp near the lake, we sleep outside and make a fire.

entries.definition_en: to stay outside in a tent for fun
entries.example_en: Our class goes camping in the mountains.
entries.example_vi: Lớp mình đi cắm trại trên núi.
entries.cloze_en: Our class will go camping in the mountains and sleep outside.

entries.definition_en: the heat and light when something burns
entries.example_en: We sit around the fire and sing songs.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình ngồi quanh đống lửa và hát.
entries.cloze_en: It's cold at night, so we sit around the fire and sing songs.

entries.definition_en: a small green animal that jumps and lives near water
entries.example_en: We hear frogs at night after the rain.
entries.example_vi: Sau mưa ban đêm tụi mình nghe tiếng ếch kêu.
entries.cloze_en: A small green frog jumps into the river.

entries.definition_en: far above the ground
entries.example_en: The kite flies high in the sky.
entries.example_vi: Con diều bay cao trên bầu trời.
entries.cloze_en: This mountain is very high, so it takes all day to climb.

entries.definition_en: a small mountain
entries.example_en: Our school is on a small hill.
entries.example_vi: Trường mình nằm trên một ngọn đồi nhỏ.
entries.cloze_en: Our school is on a small hill, so we walk up every morning.

entries.definition_en: a toy that flies in the wind on a long string
entries.example_en: Children fly kites in the field.
entries.example_vi: Trẻ con thả diều trên cánh đồng.
entries.cloze_en: On windy days, children fly a kite in the field.

entries.definition_en: a flat green part of a plant
entries.example_en: The leaves turn yellow in the fall.
entries.example_vi: Mùa thu lá chuyển sang màu vàng.
entries.cloze_en: In autumn, this leaf on the tree is yellow, not green.

entries.definition_en: to give food to your cat
entries.example_en: Can you feed the cat before school?
entries.example_vi: Con cho mèo ăn trước khi đi học nhé?
entries.cloze_en: Our cat is hungry. Can you feed the cat before school?

entries.definition_en: an area of land with grass or crops
entries.example_en: The rice fields are green in summer.
entries.example_vi: Mùa hè những cánh đồng lúa xanh mướt.
entries.cloze_en: The farmer grows rice in the green field.

entries.definition_en: a very small animal with a long tail
entries.example_en: A little mouse runs under the table.
entries.example_vi: Một con chuột nhắt chạy dưới gầm bàn.
entries.cloze_en: A little mouse runs under the table, and the cat runs after it.

entries.definition_en: a farm animal with thick white wool
entries.example_en: The sheep eat grass on the hill.
entries.example_vi: Đàn cừu ăn cỏ trên đồi.
entries.cloze_en: The sheep eats grass on the hill.

entries.definition_en: a long animal with no legs
entries.example_en: We see a long green snake at the zoo.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình thấy một con rắn xanh dài ở sở thú.
entries.cloze_en: A snake is a long animal with no legs.

entries.definition_en: a small hard piece of rock
entries.example_en: The children throw stones into the river.
entries.example_vi: Bọn trẻ ném đá xuống sông.
entries.cloze_en: This stone is very hard and heavy.

entries.definition_en: the surface of the earth
entries.example_en: The ground is wet after the rain.
entries.example_vi: Sau mưa mặt đất ướt.
entries.cloze_en: After the rain, the ground in the garden is wet.

entries.definition_en: land with water all around it
entries.example_en: There are many islands in Ha Long Bay.
entries.example_vi: Vịnh Hạ Long có rất nhiều hòn đảo.
entries.cloze_en: An island has water all around it.

entries.definition_en: to put a young tree in the ground
entries.example_en: Every student plants a tree at school.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi học sinh trồng một cái cây ở trường.
entries.cloze_en: Every student will plant a tree at school, and it will grow big.

entries.definition_en: the activity of catching fish
entries.example_en: Fishing is my grandpa's hobby.
entries.example_vi: Câu cá là sở thích của ông mình.
entries.cloze_en: Grandpa loves fishing at the river. He gets many fish.

entries.definition_en: an insect with large colorful wings
entries.example_en: A beautiful butterfly flies in the garden.
entries.example_vi: Một con bướm xinh bay trong vườn.
entries.cloze_en: A beautiful butterfly flies from flower to flower in the garden.

entries.definition_en: an animal like a big mouse
entries.example_en: A rat lives under the old house.
entries.example_vi: Có một con chuột cống sống dưới ngôi nhà cũ.
entries.cloze_en: A big rat lives under the old house and eats our rice.

entries.definition_en: food for farm animals
entries.example_en: Grandma gives the chickens their feed.
entries.example_vi: Bà cho gà ăn cám.
entries.cloze_en: Grandma gives the chickens their feed every morning.

entries.definition_en: an empty space in something
entries.example_en: The dog digs a hole in the yard.
entries.example_vi: Con chó đào một cái hố ngoài sân.
entries.cloze_en: There is a big hole in the street, so be careful.

entries.definition_en: a flower with a sweet smell, often red
entries.example_en: My dad gives my mom red roses.
entries.example_vi: Bố tặng mẹ những bông hồng đỏ.
entries.cloze_en: My dad gives my mom a red rose.

entries.definition_en: a time when you swim
entries.example_en: Let's go for a swim in the lake.
entries.example_vi: Mình đi bơi một vòng ở hồ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: It's hot. Let's go for a swim in the lake.

entries.definition_en: to go up a mountain on foot
entries.example_en: We want to climb a mountain next summer.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình muốn leo núi vào hè năm sau.
entries.cloze_en: We want to climb a mountain and see the city from the top.

entries.definition_en: a time when you go up something high
entries.example_en: It's a long climb to the top.
entries.example_vi: Leo lên tới đỉnh khá xa.
entries.cloze_en: It's a long climb to the top of the mountain.

entries.definition_en: dirty air, water or land that is bad for people
entries.example_en: Pollution in the river is bad for the fish.
entries.example_vi: Ô nhiễm trên sông có hại cho cá.
entries.cloze_en: Pollution in the river is bad for the fish.

entries.definition_en: a tall flower, often white, with a sweet smell
entries.example_en: In April, Hanoi has many white lilies.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Tư Hà Nội có rất nhiều hoa loa kèn trắng.
entries.cloze_en: The lily in the vase is a big white flower.
